services.thenDetails: Then tell us a little more

booking.chooseWho: Who would you like to meet?
booking.firstAvailableHint: We will match you with whoever is free
booking.noSlots: No times are free in the next three weeks. Try someone else or contact the school office.
booking.slotTaken: That time was just taken. Please choose another.

requests.title: Requests
requests.subtitle: Every request you are part of, with live progress.
requests.cancelConfirm: Cancel this request? This cannot be undone.
requests.emergency1: Stay with the child, or make sure another adult is with them. Do not leave them alone.
requests.emergency2: Call the Designated Safeguarding Lead, {name}, now. Do not wait for a reply to this form.
requests.emergency3: If anyone is at risk of serious harm, call Dubai Police on 999 or an ambulance on 998.
requests.emergency4: Do not question the child further or contact the family yourself. The DSL will lead.
requests.emergencyAlerted: The DSL and deputy have been alerted by app, email, SMS and WhatsApp.
requests.submittedBody: Your reference is {number}. You will be notified at every step.
requests.restrictedBody: Thank you for raising this. It is being handled by the right team. Details and outcomes are restricted to protect the student. If you have new information, raise another concern.
requests.emptyBody: When you submit a service request it appears here with live progress.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.subtitle: Decisions waiting for you. Everything you approve is recorded with your name and time.
approvals.commentPlaceholder: Optional for approval, required if you decline
approvals.signLabel: Type your full name to sign
approvals.signHint: Typing your name counts as your electronic signature on this decision.
approvals.reasonNeeded: Please add a comment explaining why you are declining.
approvals.signatureNeeded: Please type your name to sign.
approvals.approvedToast: Approved. The next step has started.
approvals.rejectedToast: Declined. The requester has been told.
approvals.failed: That did not work. Please try again.
approvals.emptyBody: New approvals will appear here and in your notifications.

safeguarding.title: Safeguarding
safeguarding.subtitle: If you are worried about a child, raise it. You do not need to be certain.
safeguarding.casesHint: Restricted to the DSL, the deputy and explicitly granted staff.
safeguarding.myConcernsHint: You will see when each concern is received and being handled. Details stay restricted.
safeguarding.noMyConcerns: You have not raised any concerns.
safeguarding.guidance: Listen, do not investigate. Record the child's own words. Never promise to keep a secret. If a child is in immediate danger, stay with them and call the DSL now.

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.subtitle: Your upcoming and past meetings.
meetings.noUpcomingBody: Book a meeting with a teacher, counselor or advisor in a few taps.
meetings.rescheduleHint: Pick a new time. Everyone is told automatically.
meetings.slotTaken: That time was just taken. Please choose another.
meetings.bookSubtitle: Choose the type of meeting, the student and a time.
meetings.noTypes: No meeting types are available to you.
meetings.sensitiveInvite: This is a confidential case. Inviting parents is your recorded decision.

cases.title: Cases
cases.subtitle: Student support cases you work on. Wellbeing and safeguarding cases follow stricter access rules.
cases.search: Search by student or case number
cases.emptyBody: Try another view or clear the filters.

caseForms.notePlaceholder: What happened, who was involved, what was agreed. Facts, not opinions.
caseForms.immutable: Notes are timestamped and cannot be deleted.
caseForms.immutableSensitive: Restricted chronology. Notes can be amended, never deleted.
caseForms.amendHint: The original stays in the record. Your change is saved as a new version with a reason.
caseForms.parentMessage: Message to the family (optional). Keep it brief and invite a conversation.
caseForms.decisionReason: Reason for this decision (required, recorded in the chronology)
caseForms.referralHint: Record referrals to agencies such as the Child Protection Unit.
caseForms.agencyPlaceholder: For example, Dubai Police Child Protection Unit
caseForms.subject: Subject
caseForms.breakGlassReason: Explain the emergency in writing. The DSL is alerted and this is audited.
caseForms.breakGlassDone: Emergency access granted. The DSL has been alerted.

error.generic: That did not work. Please try again.
error.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do that.
error.DECISION_REQUIRED: Record a decision to notify parents first.

ai.disabled: AI is turned off for this school.
ai.sensitiveBlocked: This case contains wellbeing, safeguarding or medical information. The school has not allowed it to be sent to an AI provider.
ai.briefIntro: Prepare a pre-meeting brief with suggested questions from the case record.
ai.draftNotice: Draft. Check it before you rely on it.

plan.title: Action plan
plan.blocked: AI is not allowed for this case. Write the plan yourself.
plan.failed: Could not draft a plan. Please try again.
plan.reviewHint: Edit any step, then approve. Steps become tasks for the student and staff.
plan.noAutoParents: Families are not updated automatically on confidential cases.

case.statusOnlyBody: Thank you. The right team has it. Details and outcomes are restricted to protect the student.
case.restrictedBody: Only the safeguarding team can open this case. In an emergency you can use break-glass access, which alerts the DSL and is audited.
case.breakGlassBanner: Emergency access in use. Your access expires in 60 minutes and every view is audited.
case.sgBanner: Restricted safeguarding case. Excluded from search, dashboards and analytics. Every view is audited.
case.wbBanner: Confidential wellbeing case. The family is only contacted by a recorded staff decision.
case.parentNotificationHint: Never automatic. Record each decision and the reason.
case.rule1: Every entry is timestamped with who wrote it.
case.rule2: Notes can be amended with a reason. Earlier versions are kept.
case.noAppointments: No meetings for this case yet.
case.docsSensitive: Only documents attached to this case are shown.
case.docsHint: Case documents and the student's general documents.
case.uploadHint: Upload files to the student's record from Documents.
case.noForms: No forms linked to this case.
case.emailNeedsDecision: Record a decision to notify parents on the Overview tab first.
case.familyNotAuto: Not contacted automatically. See parent notification decisions.
case.accessGrantsHint: Time-limited, with a reason, and audited.

career.explorerSubtitle: {count} careers, with what they involve and how to get there.
career.assessmentIntro: 45 short statements. There are no right or wrong answers. Go with your first instinct.
career.notTaken: This student has not taken the assessment yet
career.startBody: A 10 minute assessment across nine strengths, matched against more than 40 careers in demand in the UAE and around the world.
career.nextStep: Next step: book a session with your career advisor to plan subjects and universities.
career.chosenToast: Great choice. Your advisor has been told.
career.shortlistHint: Balance reach, target and safety choices. Tick requirements as you go.
career.reviewHint: Recommendations stay preliminary until you approve them. Parents only see approved ones.
career.advisorSubtitle: Students who have taken the assessment, newest first.
